batches.objective: Reject WGSL keywords used as variable identifiers while preserving valid type aliases, diagnostics and pointer semantics.
batches.rationale: The independent pinned Dawn run rejects the alias identifier in an ordinary shader fixture, while Doe accepts it. Correct the first language-admission boundary; renaming the fixture does not repair compiler validation.
batches.nextAction: Reproduce the keyword fixture from the retained generated-execution report, trace identifier admission, repair its semantic owner and exercise valid alias declarations plus rejected declaration/use sites.
acceptance: Invalid keyword identifiers fail with source-linked diagnostics; valid aliases and named pointer references retain their semantics.
Combined runtime/full/WGSL suites and physical package computation/render checks pass.
batches.stopCondition: One reproduced keyword-admission gap is repaired and independently validated; no broader conformance credit.

batches.objective: Select one Vulkan generated-program optimization from recoverable unchanged-application execution cost.
batches.rationale: The retained loop-invariant candidate produces fewer instructions but lacks the declared GPU gain and repeatedly regresses complete-operation medians. UMAP pass times account for only part of ordinary operation cost. Select the next correction from measured application contribution.
batches.nextAction: Attribute remaining generated execution and ordinary operation cost under the existing unchanged application and transfer fixtures. Require measured recoverable cost before selecting the next IR or SPIR-V transformation.
acceptance: Numerical, bounds and alias semantics are preserved through independent physical output oracles; existing runtime and full WGSL suites pass.

Compiler time and allocations, generated-program execution time, full application latency and memory are measured independently against the accepted baseline and pinned Dawn, with declared regression limits and every cohort retained.
batches.stopCondition: Retain or reject one measured Vulkan candidate; no shader optimization or application superiority is inferred from preparation savings alone.
requiredEnvironment: Physical AMD Vulkan provider and final-program profiling
Pinned Dawn control and unchanged application inputs
